technical.summary: ACN shows oversold conditions but lacks bullish confirmation; price remains below all key moving averages with negative momentum, making this a weak swing entry despite oversold technicals.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 45 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (2 sales vs 1 small purchase) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (448), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinationals, CPI event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 45 days creates binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (stoch, Williams %R, StochRSI) combined with fear-zone sentiment (14/100) and price near support (273.68) create a classic contrarian bounce setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Complete absence of bullish confirmation—price below all moving averages, negative momentum (MACD, CMF), weak ADX trend, zero insider conviction, macro crisis (VIX 448, flat yield curve, DXY headwind), and CPI volatility in 2 days make this a value trap, not a bounce.
